notes:
0.14.11.0
- Fixed: zombies from nests and hive nodes could appear inside closed houses and stack up in a corner. They now always appear on open ground.
- Molotovs and every other fire puddle now set hive nodes (and nests) alight when the fire touches them.
- You can now aim at things right in front of your hero: the guns turn toward the cursor instead of snapping straight ahead.
- Customization: the preview is lit like the game and you turn the character, not the camera. New "Class look" buttons show your hero as any class you have mastered.
- The Tesla Marine's cap symbol is now a proper thunderbolt.
- Zombies are faster later in the day: x1.25 on the Day-Night Cycle, x1.5 at Night, x1.75 on Terror Night.
- Grenades are found twice as often.
- An item you just found is less likely to drop again only for a while: the reduction wears off over time.
- A Siren's jam no longer shows a warning line, red screen edge or marker. You hear it instead (a crackle when jammed, a chirp when free), and your skill boxes show red padlocks.
